ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has released the exam date for the post of Scientist / Engineer. This recruitment was released for 175 posts. Online applying process for ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 August 2026 to 16 September 2026. The CBT examination is going to conducted on 19 October 2026.
